justification: Issue #752: the brief's Secondary Dwelling card only ever fired action:'detect', so the yield outputs (max_floor_area_m2, estimated_weekly_rent_aud, rental_yield_annual_pct, assumed_build_cost_aud) were structurally absent from the brief. This wires the human structure-selection + explicit calculate step into the card against the existing gated route. Standard, not critical: purely additive UI flow behind an explicit click, no schema change, no bulk data operation — but user-facing money figures make silent-wrong-result modes worth adversarial coverage.

pre_impl.existing_data: No stored rows change shape: detect still pre-allocates the same granny_flat_reports row, and the calculate step still writes through the existing Python /pipeline/granny-flat/confirm path; the card extraction moves JSX out of page.tsx verbatim for the detect states.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The #748 three-state detect contract is load-bearing: samgeo_structure_count can be null with detection_failed true, so the selection step is gated on a successful detect (detection_failed false AND sepp_eligible AND detect_id present) — a failed scan renders unknown-not-zero and offers no calculate button.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every future brief run with satellite on; nothing to backfill because past briefs never stored the calculate output. The standalone tool's flow is untouched — it still omits lot_area_m2 from the body, so the route's new caller-supplied-area preference changes nothing for it.

functions.name: GrannyFlatBriefCard
functions.input: address, active flag, and the brief's reconciled lotAreaM2 prop (#745 D3 single lot-area figure)
functions.output: the Secondary Dwelling card through detect states plus the new selection affordance, yield block, or visible calculate error
functions.if_none: inactive or missing address renders the Not-run shell and fires no network call at all

functions.name: runConfirm
functions.input: the successful detect result plus the user's structure deselections and the existing-secondary-dwelling answer
functions.output: POST action:'confirm' mirroring the standalone tool's request shape (detect_id, confirmed_structure_count, echoed samgeo count, postcode, main dwelling area, reconciled lot area)
functions.if_none: missing address or detect_id returns early without any request; a non-ok response sets a visible error state and renders no figures

functions.name: YieldBlock
functions.input: the calculate response's nullable money fields plus confidence and confidence_reason
functions.output: the four labelled indicative-yield rows with confidence_reason surfaced verbatim
functions.if_none: any null money field renders the words Not available — a null is never coerced to a zero figure

values.value: detect_id from the polled detect outputs
values.if_missing: canCalculate stays false, so the card keeps the old advisory footer and never offers a calculate button it cannot honour

values.value: samgeo_structure_count echoed into the calculate body
values.if_missing: null is sent explicitly (never 0), matching the #748 unknown-is-not-zero contract the Python confidence logic keys off

values.value: caller-supplied lot_area_m2 in the route's calculate branch
values.if_missing: falls back to the existing shoelace computation from lot geometry, so the standalone tool's behaviour is byte-identical

values.value: estimated_weekly_rent_aud / rental_yield_annual_pct / assumed_build_cost_aud in the yield block
values.if_missing: each row independently renders Not available; a not-buildable response also gets an explicit could-not-be-computed sentence

break_it.scenario: Detection fails on the GPU (#748 three-state: samgeo_structure_count null, detection_failed true) yet the lot is SEPP-eligible
break_it.what_happens: A naive card would offer the calculate button against an unknown building count and produce a yield from garbage
break_it.how: canCalculate requires detection_failed false; the card renders the unknown-not-zero copy and no selection affordance
break_it.repro: npx jest GrannyFlatBriefCard -t 'renders the unknown-not-zero copy and no selection affordance'

break_it.scenario: The calculate endpoint returns 502 (Python rent service down) after the user clicks the button
break_it.what_happens: Without an error state the card could render an empty yield block or zeroed dollar figures
break_it.how: non-ok responses set a role=alert error with the response message, keep the retry button, and render no yield block
break_it.repro: npx jest GrannyFlatBriefCard -t 'renders a visible error with the response message and no yield figures'

break_it.scenario: Calculate succeeds but the lot is not buildable — rent, yield and build cost come back null
break_it.what_happens: Coercing nulls through Math.round or template strings would show $0/wk and 0% p.a., a silent wrong money figure
break_it.how: every money row null-checks independently and renders the words Not available; tests assert no $0 and no 0% strings
break_it.repro: npx jest GrannyFlatBriefCard -t 'renders "Not available" for null money fields'

break_it.scenario: A re-render, polling race, or stray effect fires the calculate call without the user clicking
break_it.what_happens: The mandatory human-selection step would be bypassed and GPU-derived figures served unreviewed
break_it.how: the request runs only from the button's onClick handler and is re-entry guarded while submitting; a test advances timers 10s post-detect and asserts zero calculate requests
break_it.repro: npx jest GrannyFlatBriefCard -t 'never fires the confirm action without an explicit click'

break_it.scenario: The brief passes its reconciled lot area but the route's calculate branch recomputes shoelace area from geometry
break_it.what_happens: The yield would be computed on a different lot area than every other brief card displays (#745 D3 regression)
break_it.how: the route's calculate branch now prefers the caller-supplied lot_area_m2 and only falls back to shoelace when absent; the request-shape test pins lot_area_m2 in the body
break_it.repro: npx jest GrannyFlatBriefCard -t 'sends the standalone tool request shape'

break_it.scenario: User deselects a structure that the aerial view shows is not on the lot, then calculates the yield
break_it.what_happens: If selections were ignored the confirmed_structure_count would silently echo the AI count, defeating the human step
break_it.how: confirmed_structure_count is derived from the live selection state (2 detected, shed deselected sends 1), asserted against the captured request body
break_it.repro: npx jest GrannyFlatBriefCard -t 'sends the standalone tool request shape'

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — run a brief with satellite on for a SEPP-eligible address (e.g. 14 Stanley St Concord), click through the selection step on the Secondary Dwelling card, and compare the yield figures against the standalone /reports/granny-flat run for the same address
